correctness.rationale: In the edge-seeded unrooted tree C counts all unordered leaf pairs at a common neighbor, not only centers of degree three. Start the leaf drifts at n=3, with (S,X,C)=(6,4,1), where S=sum d² and X=sum d·ell. Attachment at a nonleaf adds ell pairs and d+ell+1 to X; attachment at a leaf loses ell_w-1 pairs at its old neighbor w and changes X by 2-d_w. Degree-weighted averaging gives E[ΔX|T_n]=1+S_n/[2(n-1)] and (n-1)E[C_(n+1)|T_n]=(n-2)C_n+X_n/2. The S drift is E[S_(n+1)|T_n]=nS_n/(n-1)+2; telescoping these three identities from the deterministic starts reproduces the exact finite mean. With U=sum d³, its expected growth recursion has multiplier 1+3/[2(n-1)] and forcing O(log n); dividing by the product of multipliers, of order n^(3/2), gives E U_n=O(n^(3/2)). The martingale increments of M are (2d_selected-S_n/(n-1))/n, with expected square summable via U. The star and path at n=4 are equiprobable and give M_4=±1/3. The centered X-increment's expected square is O(n^(1/2)): contributions at leaves combine by old neighbor and use ell_w≤d_w, as do the nonleaf degree weights. The C-increment innovation multiplied by n-1 has expected square O(n^(5/2)) by the same bound. Dividing these by n and n² respectively gives square-summable martingale series; Kronecker gives the required almost-sure noise control and orthogonality gives L² control. Cesàro first transfers the limit to centered X_n/n as M∞/2; the weighted sum of those centered X values then transfers it to centered C_n/n as M∞/8. The mean contributes γ/4−1/8 after subtracting (log n)/4, and the limiting variance is at least (1/9)/64. broader_coverage.reasoning: Knowing all fixed-shape limits without uniform summation control does not give an unbounded quadratic aggregate. Likewise the maximum leafdegree approximation is not o(n) control of its global squared sum: summing degree times the uniform error can be much larger than n. A Zagreb-index result alone does not transfer the fluctuations to leaf pairs.

The centered degree martingale and its L² convergence are readily obtained from those facts and are not credited as a standalone novelty. The inspected prior work does not supply the corresponding transfer to the unbounded sibling statistic.
residual_risks: No claim of historical priority. More general additive-functional or degree-sequence work could cover a component of the proof or the result; the 2025 degree-sequence full text was not retrieved. The pass does not depend on treating the Zagreb martingale or its mean as new.

value.rationale: This global leaf-pair statistic counts symmetries at all occupied centers and weights hubs quadratically. The result goes beyond an existence result or a density limit: it separates a deterministic n log n leading term from an order-n, genuinely random limit that can be tracked via quadratic degrees, with an exact finite-size expectation. The moment control that transfers fluctuations to this unbounded observable is substantive, and the statistic and scale are naturally motivated by the heavy-tailed leafdegree law.
